El Niño Linked to Extreme Weather Events Globally

El Niño has been linked to extreme weather events worldwide, including record rainfall in Tokyo and a desert bloom in Chile. Tokyo experienced 35 consecutive days of rain, its highest in centuries, attributed to El Niño. Additionally, a key Pacific zone recorded a temperature record, according to an EU monitor.
